title: Interactive session profiles
highlights: Start interactive TUI sessions with --profile, switch profiles for future turns with /profile, or clear the selection with /profile none
Inspect configured and effective profiles with profile list, show, current, and resolve without initializing a provider
improvements: Profiles now expose all, allowlist, and none skill modes with subtractive disabled_skills enforcement across activation, discovery, retrieval, and prompt context
Child agents and swarm workers inherit the active profile, tool policy, and skill restrictions unless explicitly overridden
Session restore keeps a credential-free resolved snapshot and warns when the saved profile is missing or changed instead of silently falling back
Profile values compose with explicit flags and environment overrides while preserving existing headless run modes and no-profile behavior
Unknown profiles and invalid profile fields fail before a provider request with actionable diagnostics
